summary:
**SONORA: The Sound of a Changing Earth**

SONORA is an interactive Earth sonification platform that transforms NASA's Earth science visualizations and environmental datasets into dynamic, meaningful sound experiences. By translating scientific variables such as temperature, atmospheric conditions, ocean changes, and vegetation patterns into musical elements like pitch, rhythm, tempo, and sound intensity, SONORA allows users to hear how our planet is changing over time.

Unlike conventional visualization tools, SONORA creates a synchronized audio-visual experience where every sound represents an underlying scientific measurement rather than randomly generated music. Users can explore environmental phenomena, compare changes across time periods, and experience Earth's interconnected systems through sound.

The project addresses the challenge of making Earth science more accessible, engaging, and inclusive, particularly for visually impaired individuals and auditory learners. By combining scientific data, interactive visualization, and real-time sonification, SONORA transforms complex planetary information into an experience that people can understand, explore, and connect with.

**Our vision is simple: Don't just see a changing Earth. Hear it.**
details:
## Project Overview - SONORA: The Sound of a Changing Earth

SONORA is an interactive and inclusive earth sonification application which has been created as a solution to NASA’s challenge 'The Earth Information Jukebox’. It allows the user to take complicated measurements and turn them into sound, making them easier to understand whilst also being able to visualise how the Earth is changing.

## Functionality

SONORA offers a data to sound approach. Measurements taken from the environment, such as atmospheric conditions and air quality measurements, can be converted to properties of music and sound. The pitch in the audio will represent the normalised value, the tempo will represent how much the value is changing, the volume will represent how large the measurement is and the texture of the sound will represent a different variable. This will create a cohesive sound and visual experience where every aspect of the sound will have a scientific meaning.

There are 4 main components in the platform.

Sonic Fingerprint - Using audio to create distinctive fingerprints to give the user an easy way to identify what variable they are looking at.

Time Travel - Allows the user to compare variables from different points in time.

Anomaly Alert - Using thresholding to identify any anomalies within the data. This will be highlighted using distinctive sounds and visuals.

Blind Earth Explorer - Using audio to help navigate, providing scientific explanations through speech and ensuring the application is accessible to visually impaired users.

## Benefits

SONORA aims to make earth science more inclusive, easy to understand and enjoyable. It provides a new way to understand complex scientific data, helps visually impaired users and those who learn better with their hearing. It helps raise awareness about environmental changes by converting the numbers into easily identifiable sounds, making it easier for the user to gain an intuitive understanding of the changes in the environment.

## Tools Used

This was created as a web based application. React, TypeScript, Vite and Tailwind CSS were used. Recharts was used for interactive data visualisation, Web Audio API was used to produce synthesised sounds and the Speech Synthesis API in the browser was used for audio explanations. This prototype does not claim to have access to real data from NASA, the data has been simulated locally.

## Creativity

We wanted to use sound as a way to communicate scientific data. Unlike typical data visualisation applications, we have used consistent sound to communicate the data. We also considered accessibility, scientific understanding, usability, responsiveness and simulated data.

We focused on creating a practical and interactive prototype to show how earth science, sound technology and inclusive design can work together.

## Vision

The Earth is always changing, with SONORA we give everyone a new way to listen and understand these changes.
